title: Challenge 2.4: Complete Diagnostic Matrix
description: Build a comprehensive diagnostic system using all FOR loop techniques: IN RANGE, inline lists, ENUMERATE, and nested loops.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, time to prove your iteration mastery. Build a complete diagnostic matrix using EVERY loop technique we've learned!"
story.context: This challenge combines all FOR loop concepts: numeric ranges, inline values, enumeration, and nested iteration. Real-world automation complexity!
story.success: MENTOR-9: "OUTSTANDING! You've mastered iteration - the backbone of automation. This is professional-grade looping!"

instructions: Create the *** Test Cases *** section with test: 'Complete Diagnostic Matrix'
Part 1 - Countdown sequence: FOR loop with IN RANGE from 3 to 0 (countdown), log 'Diagnostic startup: ${count}'
Part 2 - Status check: FOR loop inline through BOOTING, READY, ACTIVE, log 'System phase: ${phase}'
Part 3 - Enumerated report: Create @{systems} with power, sensors, navigation, FOR with ENUMERATE start=1, log 'System ${num}: ${sys} - checking...'
Part 4 - Multi-zone matrix: @{zones} = Alpha, Beta; @{levels} = HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW; nested FOR loops, log 'Zone ${zone} priority ${level}'
All parts in ONE test case, executed sequentially
hints: Part 2: FOR ${phase} IN BOOTING READY ACTIVE
Total: ~15 log statements across 4 loop types
solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Complete Diagnostic Matrix
    # Part 1: Countdown
    FOR    ${count}    IN RANGE    3    0    -1
        Log    Diagnostic startup: ${count}
    END
    
    # Part 2: Status phases
    FOR    ${phase}    IN    BOOTING    READY    ACTIVE
        Log    System phase: ${phase}
    END
    
    # Part 3: Enumerated systems
    @{systems}=    Create List    power    sensors    navigation
    FOR    ${num}    ${sys}    IN ENUMERATE    @{systems}    start=1
        Log    System ${num}: ${sys} - checking...
    END
    
    # Part 4: Multi-zone matrix
    @{zones}=    Create List    Alpha    Beta
    @{levels}=    Create List    HIGH    MEDIUM    LOW
    FOR    ${zone}    IN    @{zones}
        FOR    ${level}    IN    @{levels}
            Log    Zone ${zone} priority ${level}
        END
    END

theory.title: Challenge 2.4: Diagnostic Matrix
theory.content:
🎯 The Iteration Master

MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, you've learned every loop technique. Now combine them all into one comprehensive diagnostic!"

"Countdown, phases, enumeration, matrices - this is what real automation looks like!"

🧠 Challenge Requirements

You Must Demonstrate:

  • ✅ IN RANGE - Countdown sequence (3, 2, 1)
  • ✅ Inline iteration - Status phases (BOOTING, READY, ACTIVE)
  • ✅ ENUMERATE - Numbered system list (start=1)
  • ✅ Nested loops - Zone-priority matrix (2 zones × 3 priorities)
  • ✅ Sequential execution - All four parts in one test

📝 Expected Output Flow

# Part 1: Countdown (3 iterations)
Diagnostic startup: 3
Diagnostic startup: 2
Diagnostic startup: 1

# Part 2: Phases (3 iterations)
System phase: BOOTING
System phase: READY
System phase: ACTIVE

# Part 3: Enumerated (3 iterations)
System 1: power - checking...
System 2: sensors - checking...
System 3: navigation - checking...

# Part 4: Matrix (2 × 3 = 6 iterations)
Zone Alpha priority HIGH
Zone Alpha priority MEDIUM
Zone Alpha priority LOW
Zone Beta priority HIGH
Zone Beta priority MEDIUM
Zone Beta priority LOW

Total: 15 log statements from 4 different loop types!

🏅 Success Criteria

  • 🔹 4 loop types: IN RANGE, inline, ENUMERATE, nested
  • 🔹 15 total logs: 3 + 3 + 3 + 6
  • 🔹 One test case: All parts sequential
  • 🔹 Proper indentation: All loops correctly nested
  • 🔹 All tests pass: Complete execution succeeds

🎯 Your Challenge

Build the complete diagnostic matrix! Combine countdown, phases, enumeration, and multi-zone checking into one comprehensive test. Master of iteration!
